ticker: Nvidia faces deep scrutiny over China chip ties and CEO affair
Ukrainian attacks reduce Russia's oil processing capacity by 30%
Union cabinet raises rabi fertilizer subsidy by 64% to ₹62,370 crore
Twelve dead, fifty injured in Bulgarian motorway pile-up
Anthropic eyes $1.4 trillion IPO valuation in tech sector test

articles.headline: Nvidia faces intense scrutiny over China chip ties
articles.brief: Nvidia is facing mounting scrutiny following revelations regarding CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with an executive tied to a network of firms that allegedly moved banned H100 and H200 AI chips into China, prompting formal board investigations into the security and compliance breaches.

articles.headline: Anthropic eyes $1.4 trillion IPO valuation
articles.brief: Anthropic is reportedly eyeing an ambitious $1.4 trillion IPO valuation, marking a definitive major test of Wall Street's enduring fervor for artificial intelligence companies as investor demand for generative AI leaders reaches unprecedented heights.

articles.headline: Ukraine strikes reduce Russian oil processing capacity
articles.brief: Recent strategic Ukrainian drone and missile attacks have successfully reduced Russia's domestic oil processing capacity by an estimated 30%, according to industry sources closely monitoring the ongoing conflict's impact on energy infrastructure.

articles.headline: US House blocks Defense Secretary Hegseth impeachment
articles.brief: The United States House of Representatives officially blocked a legislative bid to impeach Defense Secretary Hegseth, defusing an escalating political showdown in Washington amid sharp partisan divisions over executive branch leadership and policy.

articles.headline: Twelve dead in Bulgarian motorway pile-up
articles.brief: At least twelve people have been killed and fifty others injured following a massive multi-vehicle motorway pile-up in Bulgaria, prompting an emergency response from local authorities and medical transport teams.

articles.headline: Three workers die at Tata iPhone parts factory
articles.brief: Three workers have tragically died at a Tata electronics iPhone parts manufacturing facility in India, marking the latest serious safety incident to draw scrutiny regarding industrial working conditions and factory protocol enforcement.

articles.headline: Cabinet approves ₹2,390 crore Noida metro rail link
articles.brief: The Union Cabinet, chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, has approved a ₹2,390 crore metro rail link extending from Noida Sector 51 to Greater Noida Sector 4, significantly enhancing urban transport infrastructure in the national capital region.

articles.headline: Union cabinet raises rabi fertilizer subsidy by 64%
articles.brief: The Central government has raised the rabi fertilizer subsidy by 64% to ₹62,370 crore for the upcoming agricultural season, alongside approving substantial credit guarantees to support disadvantaged micro-entrepreneurs and farmers nationwide.

articles.headline: Mother Dairy and Amul hike milk prices
articles.brief: Major dairy distributors Mother Dairy and Amul have announced price hikes of up to ₹6 per litre across various milk variants in the Delhi-NCR region, driven by escalating production costs and dwindling supply chains.

articles.headline: Niraj Kumar wins historic World Championship bronze medal
articles.brief: Shooter Niraj Kumar secured a bronze medal in the men's 50m rifle 3 positions event at the ISSF World Championships, successfully earning an official quota place for India ahead of the Los Angeles 2028 Olympic Games.

articles.headline: Qualcomm India faces over 1,000 job cuts in global restructuring
articles.brief: Qualcomm India is bracing for over 1,000 job cuts as part of a performance-focused global workforce reduction ordered by CEO Cristiano Amon, with severance packages offering up to three months of salary.

articles.headline: Supreme Court directs strict measures on polluting vehicles
articles.brief: The Supreme Court has directed government authorities across Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, Haryana, and Rajasthan to submit comprehensive action plans within two weeks to tackle severe vehicular air pollution plaguing the national capital region.

articles.headline: Trump signals readiness for Iran strikes if diplomacy fails
articles.brief: Former US President Donald Trump stated that regional powers like Qatar and Saudi Arabia desire a peaceful resolution with Iran, while affirming that the United States remains fully prepared to execute military strikes if negotiations break down.

articles.headline: Singapore Airlines flight makes emergency landing in Australia
articles.brief: A Singapore Airlines flight was forced to execute an emergency landing at an Australian airport after smoke was detected in the cabin, prompting an immediate safety inspection by aviation authorities.

articles.headline: Delhi student wins Diana Award for low-cost air purifier
articles.brief: Krish Aggarwal, a student at Delhi's Sanskriti School, won the 2026 Diana Award for co-founding an initiative that converts ordinary classroom cooling fans into affordable air purifiers across underprivileged schools.
